title: International Foundation Diploma In Accountancy (Level 3)
description: Strengthen your accounting expertise with the International Foundation Diploma in Accountancy (Level 3).
longDescription: An Accountancy course provides a solid foundation in Recording Financial Transactions,Management Information and Maintaining Financial Records . It equips students with essential skills in financial analysis, reporting, and decision-making for business success. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 60 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners.
courseDetails: The Endorsed Diploma in Accountancy (Level 3) course covers key areas such as Recording Financial Transactions, Management Information, and Maintaining Financial Records. Students learn to prepare and analyze financial statements, manage budgets, and ensure compliance with regulatory standards. The course also emphasizes the development of analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills. Graduates are well equipped for careers in accounting, finance, and business management.

entry: Endorsed Diploma In Accountancy (Level-3), learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details.
progression: Upon completing the Endorsed Diploma In Accountancy (Level-3) students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a master's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as business administration, finance, or marketing.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
gettingStartedIntro: Complete the application, document review, offer, payment and enrolment steps through the learner portal.

modules.title: Management Information
modules.summary: Module Overview: The Management Information Transactions module focuses on the fundamental processes involved in collecting, recording, and analyzing management information to support business decision-making. Students will explore various types of management information, methods of recording transactions, and the role of financial data in operational and strategic management. The module will equip students with essential skills in managing business data, preparing reports, and understanding the impact of transactions on business performance.

modules.title: Maintaining Financial Records
modules.summary: Module Overview: The "Maintaining Financial Records" module introduces students to the essential principles and practices of recording, maintaining, and organizing financial transactions. It covers the preparation and management of key financial documents and records, ensuring compliance with accounting standards. Students will learn how to accurately record transactions, prepare financial statements, and manage accounting systems for effective financial control. This module is designed to equip students with practical skills for maintaining accurate and reliable financial records in various business contexts.
